perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.desc: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.desc: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Stability. Rapid-Fire Frame(260) Kinetic Scout Rifle Primary Ammo. "Randy’s Throwing Knife is back! My favorite little scout-auto love child. This time with random rolls!!! I do enjoy seeing older ritual / pinnacle weapons refreshed with more options, especially post sunsetting. It does feel good grinding them out again. Randy’s Throwing Knife was the best rapid-fire scout for its time but unfortunately fell into a time where scouts were just awful to use and did not have a set place outside of MIDA Multi-Tool or a few specific options. Randy’s Throwing Knife with Kinetic Tremors will feel great as it fires fast enough to get the AoE back to back. Cascade Point is really funny to me, seeing a 260 scout bumping the RPM all the way up to 428 via D2Foundry. If this lands for me I don’t even really care about viability, it will just be fun."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Stability. Rapid-Fire Frame(260) Kinetic Scout Rifle Primary Ammo. "Randy’s Throwing Knife did find its slight niche within PvP, hopefully the new version delivers. I think it does and then some. The old version had Rapid Hit and Kill Clip, which you can get again, but with Extended Mag instead of a better mag boosting perk. You also have the option of bumping up the recoil direction making those quick headshots a lot easier. While the old Randy’s Throwing Knife didn’t have a bad roll, getting it again with slightly better options feels good."
